activity_type.description:
Filter to only receive certain activity types.

It is possible to filter multiple types: Example: `activity_type={type1}&activity_type={type2}`

items.title: ActivityType
items.description:
Type of activity sent in the app.

- `generic`: generic notification from intree


App Activity Types:

- `new_introduction`: notification for new introduction

- `new_invite`: notification for new invite

- `new_relation`: notification for new relation

- `thread_activity`: notification for thread activity.
The related object_id is a thread id.

- `new_biz_treet_share`: when a relation (app user) shares one of their treets.
The related object_id is a biz-treet id.

- `new_multiple_biz_treet_share`: push notification when multiple treets are shared
from a relation.

- `new_group_chat_invite`: notification for new group chat invite

- `reservation_expires_soon`: notification reservation is about to expire

- `reservation_expired`: notification reservation is expired

- `reserve_cooldown_over`: notification to reserve when treet cooldown is over

- `new_post`: notification for new post

Biz Activity Object Types:

- `new_biz_invite`: notification for new biz invite

- `new_biz_treet`: when a business adds a treet to a pack the user is member of.

- `new_multiple_biz_treets`: when a business adds multiple treets to a pack the user
    is member of.

- `new_multiple_biz_treets_v2`: when a business adds multiple treets to a pack the
    user is member of. The object_id is a pack id.

- `new_biz_application`: notification for new biz application to your business.

- `new_biz_owner`: when current user receives owner role of a business.

- `new_biz_ban`: when you are banned from a business.

- `new_reported_member`: when a member of your business is reported.

- `biz_application_accepted`: when user's application to join a business
    is accepted.

- `biz_group_application_accepted`: user's application to join a group is accepted.

- `re_verify_biz_membership`: when user has joined a business with
    `join_type=apply_domain`and needs to re-verify their email.

- `paid_pass_access_loss`: notification for losing access to one paid pass

- `free_pass_access_loss`: notification for losing access to one or more free passes

- `biz_kick`: when user is kicked from a business
